messages:
Alex Chen: Triage check-in — quick summary before I head into the sync: yesterday total tickets ~86 (down from 110), but we had a +30% spike in auth failures overnight. I updated the Auth macro to include the new troubleshooting steps. @Priya can you confirm counts?
Priya Patel: Confirming 86, 26 were auth-related. Most came from oauth refresh errors for iOS users. Rolling 5 into a single incident. No P1s.
Mateo Ruiz: Saw the macro update, small note: the snippet for clearing cache had a stray backtick which broke paste for some agents. Will open a PR to fix.
Jun Park: Created INC-9832 for the oauth refresh cluster. Root cause looks like token service time skew; I'm coordinating with infra. ETA for mitigation 45m.
Samira Ali: For the macros, can we add the quick command set for iOS specific steps? Agents keep asking where to find the cert checks. Suggested macro change below:```
/ios-auth-check
1) Check system time
2) Revoke + reissue token
3) Verify cert chain via openssl s_client
```
Jun Park: +1 to adding that. I'll share the openssl one-liner for the macro in a sec.
Mateo Ruiz: PR opened: #412-macro-fix. Updated the cache line, added a test screenshot example. CC @Alex for merge.
Alex Chen: Thanks. Action items: 1) Jun — mitigation + postmortem draft, 2) Priya — consolidate auth tickets into INC-9832 and update customer notes, 3) Mateo — merge macro PR and run smoke test, 4) Samira — add iOS snippet to the macro. If anyone needs handoff, I'm on call until 11:30 PST.
ticket-bot: Daily queue report — open:86 | sla-breaches:2 | p1:0 | avg-tts:3h12m. Top tags: auth(26), billing(14), perf(9).
Priya Patel: Small blocker — billing team flagged a bad macro that exposed a wrong refund URL. I put a temporary redirect in the agent guide. Will add to the board for tomorrow.
Alex Chen: Noted. If redirect needs product signoff, loop in @product. Otherwise let's treat as hotfix.
Samira Ali: I'll draft the hotfix macro and push to the stable channel for review.
Alex Chen: Great. If no objections, we'll close this thread and track items in the triage board. :thumbsup:
